[image]Oct 3, 2025 ∙ 6 minA GOVERNMENT SHUTDOWN Q&A FOR FEDERAL EMPLOYEESMost civilian federal employees are placed in one of three categories: furloughed, excepted or exempt. Furloughed employees stop working during a shutdown and aren’t paid until the end of the shutdown. Excepted employees continue to work, but similarly are not paid until after the shutdown is over.320
